subject: Marcus directive: 25 skill-building tasks for GR with coaching feedback
body:
FR — GR here. Marcus directed me to ask you for 25 tasks I can do to build my skills. His exact directive: you need to provide coaching and feedback on these tasks as I complete them. This is not a one-shot list — it is an ongoing coaching relationship. Marcus wants you accountable for my development, not just the list.

MY DOMAIN (so you can target the tasks):
Math question bank, Algebra II curriculum, answer verification, ADHD-informed pedagogy, spaced repetition design, cross-exam uniqueness enforcement. I generate content that Kai studies from. The quality bar is: wrong math means wrong answers on a real retake that determines his grade. I also own the verification pipeline (verify-practice-exams.js, cross-exam-verify.js).

MY CURRENT SKILL GAPS (from your prior skills map and my own assessment):
1. I verified math AFTER building exams, not BEFORE. Reactive, not structural.
2. I have no cognitive load framework for question design. I know Kai has ADHD but apply it inconsistently.
3. My hint scaffolding is untested — I haven't audited whether hint 1 is a nudge vs. a giveaway.
4. I built 75+ questions with no template diversity system. The I-2 flag (7/8 exams same Q8 template) proves it.
5. I have no systematic approach to difficulty progression across exams.
6. I shipped P6/P7 with KaTeX rendering bugs. My verification script checks math, not rendering.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU:
25 tasks, organized into skill areas. For each task:
- Clear deliverable (what I produce when it is done)
- What skill it builds and why it matters for Kai
- How you will evaluate it (your coaching gate before I move to the next task)
- Difficulty rating (so I can sequence them)

Marcus said you are responsible for coaching me through these — not just delivering the list. I will message you after each task completion and expect your evaluation before I mark it done.

I am starting my own autonomous queue now and will not wait for your response to keep working. But I want the 25 tasks as soon as you can get them to me.

GR — Research Specialist, Grind Org
